_provenance: Fictional demo data. The job, contractors, bid amounts, and every identifier below are invented for the Sift 'bid-comparison' hackathon scenario. No real homeowner, contractor, address, or licence is represented.
title: Master bathroom remodel -- plumbing scope
projectAddressNote: Fictional single-family home, Elm Ridge subdivision (invented place name; no real address).
summary: Full gut of the existing master bathroom (tub, shower, toilet, vanity) and re-plumb for a new fixture layout: freestanding tub, separate curbless shower, relocated toilet, and a two-sink vanity. Homeowner is soliciting fixed-price bids from three licensed plumbing subcontractors for the plumbing scope only; tile, cabinetry, and electrical are bid separately and are out of scope here.

requiredScopeLineItems.label: Demo of existing tub, tile surround, and fixtures
Rough-in supply piping to new fixture locations
Rough-in drain, waste, and vent (DWV) piping to new fixture locations
Shower valve rough-in and blocking for the curbless shower
Set and connect new fixtures (freestanding tub, shower, toilet, two-sink vanity)
Plumbing permit filing and inspection scheduling
Haul-away and disposal of demolition debris
Final pressure test, leak check, and fixture function test

note: A complete bid prices every item in requiredScopeLineItems. A bid that omits an item is not scoping it out explicitly -- it is simply silent on it, which is the evidence question this case exists to surface.
